Help

Guidance for applicants and registered partners

Registration walkthrough

  1. Open Partner registration (Form PR-2).
  2. Enter your company contact details. Fields marked as required must be completed.
  3. Submit. Validation is synchronous; if a field is flagged, correct it and submit again from the same form.
  4. When the submission is accepted, note the confirmation code shown on screen and keep it for correspondence.

Do not open a second registration record for the same company — duplicate records are purged nightly. If you are unsure whether a record already exists, ask the records office before submitting again.

Who to contact

Registration, certification and remittance questions: the records office (vendors@lakefront-vn.example, (847) 555-0137, Mon–Thu 9 a.m.–4 p.m.).

Solicitation content questions: use the contact listed on the solicitation's own page, linked from the solicitations list.
